en.info_card_1_desc: The Ministry of Transportation (MTO) requires all students to complete all classroom, homework, and in-car training modules within ONE YEAR OF THE STARTING DATE. No exceptions are permitted by MTO.

en.faq_subtitle: Clear, direct answers regarding Ontario licensing requirements, course structure, and tests.
en.faq_q1: How long does it take to complete the BDE Course?
en.faq_a1: The classroom (online theory) takes 20 hours, plus 10 hours of homework. The practical training takes 10 hours in the car. You can complete all portions in a few weeks depending on your availability. However, MTO regulations mandate that the entire course must be fully completed within one year of your registration date.
en.faq_q2: What are the benefits of completing an MTO-Approved BDE course?
en.faq_a2: There are two major benefits: 1. You qualify to take your G2 road test early, in just 8 months instead of the standard 12 months. 2. You receive an official certificate recorded in the MTO database, which insurance companies recognize for premium discounts (often up to 10-25% off depending on your insurance provider).
en.faq_q3: Can I use the driving instructor's vehicle for my official road test?
en.faq_a3: Yes! Our G2 and G packages explicitly include using our dual-brake, fully-insured instructor vehicle for your road exam. Driving the same car you practiced in greatly boosts your confidence and control during the test. We also offer this as an add-on for our standard BDE package.
en.faq_q4: How do I claim my BDE Course Certificate after graduating?
en.faq_a4: Once you successfully complete all 40 hours of BDE training (20h theory, 10h home-link, 10h in-car), we will register your completion directly on the Ministry of Transportation database. You can pick up a hard copy of your Driver's Licence History (DLH) at any ServiceOntario location for a minor MTO fee, which serves as your official proof of BDE course completion for insurance purposes.

zh.faq_subtitle: 关于安省驾照申领要求、BDE课程流程和路面考试的官方权威解答。
zh.faq_q1: 完成全套 BDE 课程大概需要多长时间？
zh.faq_a1: 在线理论部分为 20 小时（学员可自由掌握进度），课后作业 10 小时，路面实操练车为 10 小时。根据您的时间排期，最快可在几周内全部完成。但根据交通部规定，所有环节必须自注册之日起一年内全部完成，逾期需要重新缴费报名。
zh.faq_q2: 考取交通部批准的 BDE 证书有哪些核心好处？
zh.faq_a2: 主要有两大好处：1. 缩短考牌等待期：您的 G2 路试排期时间可以从标准的 12 个月缩短到 8 个月，大大节省时间。2. 保费打折：毕业后您的信息直接录入交通部数据库，购买汽车保险时，可获得保险公司提供的 10% 到 25% 不等的保费打折优惠。
zh.faq_q3: 在正式参加 G2 或 G 牌路考时，我可以使用教练车吗？
zh.faq_a3: 可以！我们的 G2 及 G 牌路考直通包中已经明确包含了一次使用教练双刹车汽车参加路考的服务。使用平日练车时最熟悉的车辆考试，不仅上手顺畅，更能极大程度地消除考试时的紧张感，帮助稳定发挥。
zh.faq_q4: 毕业后我如何领取我的 BDE 课程证书？
zh.faq_a4: 当您顺利完成全部 40 小时培训后，我们将直接在交通部官方系统上为您申报毕业。毕业信息是完全数字化的，无需纸质证书。如果您需要纸质凭证提供给保险公司，只需携带身份证件前往任何一家 ServiceOntario 网点，支付交通部的小额规费，打印一份您的“Driver's Licence History (驾驶历史档案)”即可，该档案即是您的官方认证凭证。
